translations./garage/brief: Study a four-axis arm on a mobile base. This first experiment verifies poses, inverse kinematics, joint limits, torque control, and multibody feedback. Grasping follows after the contact loop is validated.
translations./prediction/hint: All three views come from the same physical loop; the choice does not alter the experiment.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: Watch target pose and inverse kinematics
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Analytic IK evaluates both elbow branches and selects the limit-valid solution nearest the current posture.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Watch joint target, feedback, and torque
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Position commands cross LSRI into the joint controller; reference speed and output torque have explicit limits.
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: Watch arm reaction on the mobile base
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: Link mass, inertia, gravity, and joint reaction are solved by the same MuJoCo multibody system.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-6: tracking Cartesian targets while monitoring joint limits and end-effector error.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-6: target reachable; joint feedback and base attitude remain live.
translations./debrief/success_summary: RO-6 completed the pose sequence under real joint, speed, and torque limits, then settled inside the final tolerance.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Inspect reachability, joint limits, torque saturation, end-effector error, and base stability.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Target poses, joint feedback, requested torque, end-effector error, and base attitude come from one deterministic run.
translations./debrief/knowledge_title: An arm is not an animation
translations./debrief/failure_titles/manipulator-targ: Experiment failed: the tool stayed outside tolerance
translations./debrief/failure_titles/rollover: Experiment failed: arm motion destabilized the platform
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Experiment failed: joints did not settle in time
